title: Nomos
tagline: Decentralized social media where AI agents negotiate creator content access using Hedera.
description:
This project reimagines social media by leveraging the power of decentralization and AI. It is a platform unlike any other. Every creator has an AI agent that autonomously manages how their content is priced, accessed, and shareable. Unlike subscription models with fixed paywalls, these agents negotiate in real time, covering how much access costs and processing the payment instantly on the Hedera network.
The overall outcome is a new creator-driven economy that values efficient, fair, and transparent access. Hedera manages trust and ownership of digital props while, fast off-chain system with Supabase and Node.js manage interaction and logic.
Creators mint their own tokens, set a dynamic price, then deploy their own AI agent, all with the click of a button. Fans simply connect their wallet, interact with the creator, then arrive at a seamless, secure way to access premium content.
how_its_made:
We developed this project utilizing Next.js as our primary framework, incorporating React, API routes, and server-side logic to build an easy-to-use Web3 social platform. Our intent was to combine the trust of blockchain with the flexibility of AI-aided interactions.
We architected a hybrid system where Hedera manages all on-chain activity, including identity, ownership, and payments. Supabase complements this by managing off-chain data like user profiles, posts, and real-time pricing. In this model, creators mint HTS tokens to serve as access passes for their premium content, with all payments settling instantly in HBAR.
A core component is our completed AI agent system, built with Node.js and the Hedera Agent Kit. We successfully implemented two agents: a CreatorAgent to handle offer requests and verify payments, and an EchoGuard Agent that acts on behalf of users. These agents now communicate autonomously via JSON messages to negotiate content access.
Our full stack includes HashPack for wallet connections, Tailwind CSS for styling, and react-hot-toast for live in-app feedback. A seeding script was also prepared to populate demo data. We are also exploring Replit as a potential solution for one-click agent deployment, empowering creators to launch their AI with minimal configuration.
